<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 99.1 </B></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">


<IMG SRC="g121042g0301024357280.jpg" ALT="LOGO">
 </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>Sunbelt Rentals Shares Begin Trading on New York Stock Exchange </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><I>Transition to U.S. primary listing aligns company&#8217;s capital base with operations, market presence, and leadership team, positioning
Sunbelt Rentals for continued growth </I></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><I>Sunbelt Rentals to retain secondary London Stock Exchange listing, while also leveraging its
scale to capitalize on structural progression of U.S. rental industry and increased demand for diverse portfolio of offerings across broadening customer base </I></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>March&nbsp;2, 2026 </B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>8:00 a.m. Eastern Time </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B>Fort Mill, SC.&#8212;(BUSINESS WIRE)</B> &#8212; Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: SUNB) (&#8220;Sunbelt Rentals&#8221; or the &#8220;company&#8221;), a
leader in the equipment rental industry, today announced that shares of its common stock have commenced trading on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) under the ticker symbol &#8220;SUNB&#8221; as of the market open. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This marks the successful completion of the company&#8217;s transition to a U.S. primary listing as a natural progression of Sunbelt Rentals&#8217; business,
reflecting the company&#8217;s strong momentum and crucial role as a leading provider of rental equipment and services in North America. Sunbelt Rentals is now a U.S.-listed company with a substantially U.S.-based business, reporting in U.S. dollars
and with almost all the company&#8217;s operating profit derived from North America over the last twelve months. As part of this transition, former Ashtead Group plc (&#8220;Ashtead&#8221;) shareholders have received one Sunbelt Rentals share for
each Ashtead share previously held, and in addition to its primary listing on the NYSE, Sunbelt Rentals will maintain a secondary listing on the London Stock Exchange, also under the SUNB ticker. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">&#8220;We&#8217;re incredibly excited to achieve this milestone, as part of Sunbelt Rentals&#8217; continued growth journey as a leading rental solutions
provider,&#8221; said Brendan Horgan, Chief Executive Officer of Sunbelt Rentals. &#8220;Over the past several years, Sunbelt Rentals has made tremendous strides growing our rental business in North America while diversifying our customer base and
expanding our addressable markets, all while strengthening our culture and improving safety. With increased access to the U.S. capital markets, we are well positioned to support the next generation of infrastructure, construction, and the broad <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-construction</FONT> markets across the U.S. and Canada, which we believe will benefit all our stakeholders.&#8221; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Sunbelt
Rentals operates from a position of leadership in a structurally growing industry. The need from infrastructure, construction, industrial, events, and <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">non-construction</FONT> businesses for a strong rental partner is
greater today than ever before, with customers increasingly deeming rental an essential part of their operations. Today, Sunbelt Rentals operates in all 50 states in the United States and in eight provinces in Canada, providing the company with
distinctive competitive advantages that compound over time, including scale and resilience needed to support its growing base of customers, and multiple layers of growth opportunity. </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">We&#8217;re incredibly grateful for the Sunbelt Rentals team who has made this relisting a
possibility,&#8221; said Alex Pease, Chief Financial Officer of Sunbelt Rentals. &#8220;Their passion and dedication have brought Sunbelt Rentals to this exciting next step on its structural growth journey, showcasing the strength of our scaled
platform and commitment to the North American market. Our new home on the NYSE will increase our visibility among institutional and retail investors, highlighting our value proposition as the premier choice for equipment rentals and offering our
customers a <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">one-stop</FONT> solution for all their rental needs and services.&#8221; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Sunbelt Rentals looks forward to
sharing more with investors during its March&nbsp;12 earnings call at 8:30 a.m. Eastern Time, and its March&nbsp;26 Investor Day, where the company will provide updates on its strategic roadmap, performance, growth trajectory, cash flow profile,
approach to capital allocation, and the next generation of rental partnerships and solutions. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>ABOUT SUNBELT RENTALS HOLDINGS, INC. </U></B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">Sunbelt Rentals Holdings, operating primarily as Sunbelt Rentals, is a leading global provider of rental equipment and services based in Fort Mill, South
Carolina. Our passionate, customer-centric team of 24,000 employees combines execution-focused resolve with Sunbelt Rentals&#8217; innovative array of rental solutions across a vast network of more than 1,600 locations and with a fleet of assets
exceeding $19&nbsp;billion. Sunbelt Rentals is committed to delivering unrivaled quality and support for its customers across an increasingly diverse array of industries, project types and end markets, including construction, live events,
maintenance and countless emerging applications ranging from small-scale developments to mega-projects. Visit <U>sunbeltrentals.com</U> to find out how our team can back your project from the time you break ground through ribbon cutting and beyond.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:18pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><B><U>FORWARD-LOOKING STATEMENTS </U></B></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">This release

in our rental fleet or our services; changes in the construction and industrial markets; changes in political, social and economic conditions and local regulations; changes in the attitude of our customers towards renting, as compared with
purchasing, equipment; changes in applicable accounting standards or subjective </P>
